assembly: Independent field concatenation, not encoder output. Read=0 and Accepted=20; AcceptedOnce=2. Response: id, through, fixed schema UUID, canonical author string, empty claims map, evidence count; each evidence is row UUID bytes, state (tx time, node UUID bytes, sequence), content (tx time, node UUID bytes, sequence); length-prefixed ordinary row frame. Nonempty row frame: one notes batch, zero columns, one row 0x11 repeated, deleted=false, empty packed record.
